title: LUX Old Town - Pickleball, Games, Gym, Spa & Pool
description:
Welcome to our 5 bedroom, 3 bathroom Courtside Club in Old Town Scottsdale, a professionally designed and remodeled group getaway with room to play and relax.

• Private pickleball court, heated pool, and hot tub
• Game room with gym, pool table, shuffleboard, arcade games, and smart TV
• Outdoor lounge, fire pit, BBQ grill, and covered seating
• About 6 min drive to all the best dining, shopping and more in Old Town

Gather your crew and come celebrate at the Courtside Club!

 The space 
☆☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆☆
☀ Private pickleball court, heated pool, and a hot tub for all-day fun
☀ Large game room with gym, pool table, shuffleboard, arcade games, and a smart TV
☀ Covered outdoor lounge with fire pit, BBQ grill, outdoor dining, and sun loungers
☀ Professionally designed and remodeled group home in Old Town Scottsdale
☀ 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms with multiple living spaces for larger groups

Welcome to the Courtside Club, your Scottsdale stay built for groups who want space to gather, play, and unwind. This home brings together indoor entertainment, flexible sleeping arrangements, and a backyard made for long afternoons and easy evenings.

See why our guests enjoy staying with us:
"The house was amazing for our group of 8. The pool and hot tub were awesome and there was plants of furniture outside for everyone to lounge comfortably. Having our own pickleball court was amazing - we could just play anytime and we did!" - Pauline

"Great stay for a bachelor party, would highly recommend. Nicole was very responsive and helpful on questions we had throughout the weekends." - Tyler

★★ LIVING ROOM ★★
✔ Open main living area with a large sectional and smart TV
✔ Indoor fireplace for a cozy gathering spot
✔ Bright, modern finishes carry through the main floor

★★ KITCHEN & DINING ★★
✔ Large kitchen with island seating and a dining table for group meals
✔ Refrigerator, dishwasher, stove, oven, microwave, and freezer
✔ Coffee maker, blender, toaster, baking sheet, wine glasses, dishes, silverware, and cooking basics

★★ GAME ROOM ★★
✔ Pool table, shuffleboard, arcade games, and a smart TV
✔ Space for friendly competition and downtime between outings
✔ Dedicated workout equipment is also set up here

★★ BEDROOMS ★★
✔ Bedroom 1: two queen beds, smart TV, and attached bathroom
✔ Bedroom 2: king bed
✔ Bedroom 3: king bed
✔ Bedroom 4: two bunk beds with twin-over-full layout
✔ Bedroom 5: two twin beds and a smart TV

★★ BATHROOMS ★★
✔ Bathroom 1: attached to Bedroom 1 with a walk-in shower and double sinks
✔ Bathroom 2: shower/tub combo with double sinks
✔ Bathroom 3: walk-in shower

★★ OUTDOOR SPACE ★★
✔ Private backyard with a pool that can be heated for an additional fee
✔ Hot tub, cabanas, pool loungers, and a turfed area for yoga or yard games
✔ Covered outdoor living area with a smart TV and fire pit
✔ Outdoor dining table, BBQ grill, hammock, and fully fenced yard

We’d love to host your Scottsdale getaway and make it easy to settle right in.

Main Floor:
Living Room, Dining Room & Kitchen

Upstairs:
• Bedroom 1: Two Queen Beds, Smart TV w/ Attached Bath 
• Bathroom 1 : Walk in Shower, Double Sinks - Attached to Bedroom 1

• Bedroom 2: King Bed

• Bedroom 3: King Bed

• Bathroom 2: Shower/Bath Tub, Double Sinks

Downstairs:
• Bedroom 4: Two Bunk Beds (Twin over Full)

 Other things to note 
**MUST READ PRIOR TO BOOKING**

IMPORTANT DETAILS TO KNOW

NIGHTLY MINIMUM:
In an effort to prevent nuisance parties, we do not allow one night stays. 

OCCUPANCY:
Max guest count is 16 people.
The number of guests on your reservation is what is allowed at the home at any time - whether overnight or during the day. If you have any unapproved guests, your reservation is at risk of cancellation and/or additional charges. Please be aware of the # of guests you enter while booking, if your guest count changes at any time, please just let us know or update your reservation. This also helps us prepare for your reservation and ensure there is enough supplies (towels, toilet paper, etc) for your stay.
Because our home is stocked and prepared based on the number of guests in your reservation. Additional guest fees may apply for guests beyond the base count, up to the maximum allowed occupancy (16 Guests).

VENDORS:
Outside vendors require prior approval by host to ensure we are in compliance with the city and not violating the additional guest rules. We are not responsible for any fees if you book a vendor and must cancel on them because they are unapproved.

QUIET HOURS:
Quiet hours are from 10:00pm - 9:00am per Scottsdale noise ordinance. If the police are called, guests will be responsible for the fine (up to $2500)
Please be aware that we have a privacy-safe sensor that monitors noise in the backyard. Do not tamper or remove the sensor; it will notify us if touched. 

EARLY CHECK IN 
We try our best to accommodate an early check in and they must be pre-arranged. We use the time between guests to thoroughly clean and perform any maintenance tasks so it is perfect for you! Early check in fee may apply.

LATE CHECK OUT
Our home is in high demand and we often have back to back reservations. Just as we did for your arrival, we must prepare again for the next guest. 
Late check-outs may be pre-arranged (late check out fee may apply), however you must do this well in advance. Please do not ask for a late check out during your stay. Our cleaners are on a tight schedule and cannot be rescheduled.

SECURITY CAMERAS:
There is a front video doorbell that records upon motion. Do not touch, tamper or cover the camera, it is in place for guest and host security. 

IS THE POOL HEATED?
Yes! The pool can be heated for an additional fee of $75/night & must be heated for the entirety of the stay. 

DECORATIONS:
No sticky/adhesive dots, tape or decor with adhesive strips allowed (this ruins paint & wallpaper, and you will be charged for repair) Therefore we do not allow anything to be attached to any walls. 
Standalone backdrops are OK
NO confetti or glitter inside or outside, that includes confetti balloons. If used, an extra cleaning fee will be charged to the guest.

This property and all guests must comply with AZ Senate Bill SB 1168, City of Scottsdale ordinance Sections 18 - 150, 18 - 121 and all state and city regulations. **All Dwelling units, including Vacation Rentals and Short term rentals shall have a maximum family size of 6 adults (and their related dependent children).
